title: Anthropic targets Nasdaq IPO listing window
summary: Anthropic is reportedly targeting a Nasdaq listing in the September-October 2026 window at a valuation approaching $2 trillion, following its $965 billion Series H round; no exact date has been confirmed.

title: Apple's unified EU App Store business terms take effect
summary: Apple's new unified DMA-compliant EU App Store terms take effect October 1, 2026, replacing the per-install Core Technology Fee with a 26% in-app-purchase commission, a 20% alternative-payment commission and a 5% Core Technology Commission.

title: Federal agencies' post-quantum cryptography migration plans due to OMB/ONCD
